Coram : A.K. SIKRI*, ASHOK BHUSHAN
Judicial Service – Arunachal Pradesh Judicial Service Rules, 2006 – Proviso to r.7 – Consideration for regularisation – Respondent Nos.1 to 3 were appointed as Additional Deputy Commissioners with the powers of Additional Sessions Judge, on contract to man Fast Track Courts (FTC) – Respondents claimed for regularisation to the said posts and to work as Additional Sessions Judges, invoking the provisions of r.7 of the Rules – However, the Committee consisting of High Court Judges rejected the claim of the respondents –
Decision Date : 23-04-2018 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 4298/2018 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
